source_backbone.name: NFL 2026 training camp all-32 early takeaways

materiality_policy.rule: Status describes evidence relevance only. Numeric projection authority remains zero until an existing deterministic rule applies or Step 6.5 calibration authorizes a coefficient.

evidence.subject: Buffalo Bills acquisition of WR DJ Moore
evidence.reason: Verified high-volume veteran receiver acquisition changes Buffalo target competition and offensive personnel state.

evidence.subject: Buffalo defensive personnel turnover
evidence.reason: Multiple notable 2025 defensive contributors departed, including edge, defensive-line, linebacker and secondary personnel; the 2025 defensive stat line cannot be carried forward unchanged.

evidence.subject: Miami quarterback and receiver-room turnover
evidence.reason: Tua Tagovailoa, Tyreek Hill and Jaylen Waddle are listed among notable departures, requiring a new 2026 offensive baseline rather than a direct 2025 carry-forward.

evidence.subject: Cleveland defensive and offensive-line turnover
evidence.reason: Myles Garrett departed via trade and multiple established offensive linemen also departed, making both 2025 defensive strength and offensive protection priors stale without adjustment.

evidence.subject: Los Angeles Rams acquisition of Myles Garrett
evidence.reason: Elite edge acquisition has a direct pathway to pressure, sack and opposing passing-efficiency expectations and therefore cannot be represented by the Rams' unadjusted 2025 defense.

evidence.subject: Pittsburgh acquisition of WR Michael Pittman Jr.
evidence.reason: Verified starting-caliber receiver addition materially changes target competition and passing-game personnel.

evidence.subject: New Orleans early-down versus passing-down running-back usage
evidence.reason: Travis Etienne took most early-down team-drill reps while Alvin Kamara handled third-down/passing situations. Credible role evidence, but preseason deployment may not map one-for-one to regular-season shares.

evidence.subject: Arizona Jeremiyah Love listed behind Tyler Allgeier on early unofficial depth chart
evidence.reason: NFL reporting explicitly cautioned against over-evaluating an early unofficial depth chart; retain as context but do not grant numeric authority by itself.

evidence.subject: Christian McCaffrey returned after planned practice absence
evidence.reason: Return and team characterization indicate the absence was planned; retain the history but do not penalize the current projection solely for those missed practices.

evidence.subject: Luther Burden III groin injury with limited return to practice
evidence.reason: Burden returned to individual work after missing time but had not yet completed a full team-practice workload in the cited update, leaving Week 1 role/ramp uncertainty.

evidence.subject: Darnell Wright elbow issue followed by practice return
evidence.reason: The starting tackle returned to practice in the cited update; no current downgrade should be applied solely from the earlier scare, but status remains monitored.

evidence.subject: Braden Smith foot injury under evaluation
evidence.reason: Potential offensive-line loss has a direct pathway to pressure, rushing efficiency and scoring expectations, but severity/timeline were unresolved in the cited report.

evidence.subject: Tucker Kraft ACL recovery progression into 11-on-11 work
evidence.reason: Return to 11-on-11 work is positive availability evidence, but ACL recovery/ramp uncertainty remains relevant until full regular practice and Week 1 status are verified.

evidence.subject: James Conner foot recovery with Week 1 uncertainty
evidence.reason: Week 1 uncertainty plus a changed backfield creates both availability and role-share uncertainty; do not force a zero or full workload assumption.

evidence.subject: Jordyn Tyson multi-week hamstring absence
evidence.reason: Reported multi-week absence extends into the regular season and materially changes early-season availability and target competition.

evidence.subject: Tristan Wirfs returned from hamstring injury
evidence.reason: Return is positive, but offensive-line health materially affects protection/run efficiency and should remain monitored until full Week 1 availability is confirmed.

evidence.subject: Late-August trade: Kayshon Boutte to Houston / Jaylen Reed to New England
evidence.reason: Verified late-August player movement changes receiving-room depth and role competition for both teams and must be reconciled before final Week 1 projections.

evidence.subject: Late-August trade: Tutu Atwell to Miami / Jarquez Hunter to Los Angeles Rams
evidence.reason: Verified late-August roster movement changes depth/competition in both offenses and must be reflected in the current roster state.

closure_requirements: All 32 teams receive explicit acquisition/departure/coaching/injury/camp review status.
Every MATERIAL or POSSIBLY_MATERIAL item is mapped to affected engines.
No evidence receives an arbitrary numeric adjustment from its label alone.
Week 1 roster-cut transactions after this capture are ingested before final projection/ranking resync.
Roster deadline is 2026-08-30; this ledger is therefore not final until post-cut reconciliation completes.
